_doc: Declarative pages imported natively by Core (DemoPageImporter). Symbolic keys map to created content ids in the import provenance; re-import updates the same rows; reset removes only these importer-created pages. The template value must be an id declared in this theme's theme.json page_templates — undeclared ids import without a template (warning).

en.title: Welcome
en.content: This landing page was created by the Theme Example starter preset and is assigned to the custom landing page template.

vi.title: Chào mừng
vi.content: Trang đích này được tạo bởi bộ khởi đầu của Theme Example và dùng mẫu trang landing.

en.title: About the example
